measured_by: CI=true npm run test:ci (the instrument CI uses), full suite, 0 failures; raised by James's dispatch of 2026-10-28 — the Opas pane's idle and done states (opas-idle-done.test.tsx, 9 tests, one new file). `tests` is numTotalTests — it counts the skipped and todo that the 'passed' line does not.
_what_this_is: A FLOOR, not an equality. A run that executes fewer files or tests than this has not tested what this number says it tests. Growth passes and prints a reminder to raise these. Removing tests on purpose means lowering these IN THE SAME DIFF -- the number may only move in a reviewed commit, never by drift.
_why_it_exists: 2026-10-07, run cap6_10 of a worker-cap experiment: vitest printed 'Test Files 338 passed (338)' while six files never ran, because [vitest-pool-runner] timed out starting their workers. The denominator fell from 344 and the summary line still read complete. vitest cannot catch this alone -- the six were never counted, so its own collected total was already 338. Only a number written down earlier can disagree.
_files_is: len(summary.testResults) -- NOT numTotalTestSuites, which counts describe blocks (a 2-file subset reported 4).
